text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the race of the century: the<n>Emperor vs the
Beast. Speculation is<n>rampant as to who will come
out on<n>top.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The competitors themselves are no<n>exception.
Sparks fly as they size<n>each other up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Will the Emperor triumph or will the<n>Beast devour
her whole? The crowd<n>goes wild as the race
begins!
